markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Springboard](/Feats.aspx?ID=5447) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 69

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

**Requirements**
Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.

</column>

---

You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent. You [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298), which doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy you struck. If you land within melee reach of an enemy, you can choose to make a spinning talon Strike against them.
name: Springboard
requirement: Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.
